author: Haiku critic
text: The Screenshot DashedButton (runDraftAction 'shot') and the helper paragraph 'take a screenshot' depend on screen capture, which the web build does not have. Keep the feature title F04-012 (the button creates the task with an attachment), but on web the button should take an uploaded image file, and the helper copy must change to match.

author: Haiku critic
text: The title bar's traffic-light window controls (Light close, minimize, fullscreen) and the drag_indicator grip are window chrome that a browser tab already supplies. The web build should drop them, while the desktop build keeps them.

author: Haiku critic
text: The draft is defined as existing before any database row, and Escape, Discard or click-away must write nothing. On web this has to be client-side state that is only sent to the server when Enter, blur with a title, or Note/Screenshot commits it, because the backend is multi-user and a dropped draft must not leave a server record. The rule for the draft action guard (F04-119) also needs to hold across the network request.

author: Haiku critic
text: The Discard draft IconButton uses the last_page icon, which reads as navigation (next page) rather than discard. Its purpose is only clear from the tooltip. Pick a discard or close glyph for both builds, or accept the tooltip as the only label.

author: Haiku critic
text: The two DashedButtons in 'Start with' are inconsistent: the Note button uses an add icon at size 16, while the Screenshot button uses screenshot_monitor at size 15. Both sit in the same row and do the same job, so the icon size should be the same, with the glyph difference the only variation.

author: Haiku critic
text: The code and the measured values disagree for the Start with buttons (className h-10 gives 40px, but the rendered height is 35px) and for the helper paragraph (leading-4 gives 16px, but the rendered line height is 14px). The rebuild has to choose one value for each and record it, instead of leaving the two sources to conflict.

author: Haiku critic
text: The empty 20x20 completion ring placeholder is non-interactive, yet it looks like the round Select checkbox used on every task row. Its purpose (a placeholder for the ring the task will have) is not clear from the screen, so the rebuild should either label it or drop it, and avoid implying that it toggles done.

author: Haiku critic
text: The Delete list and New list buttons in ListTabs open the sheets screen. The desktop build must present these as separate windows that do not dim the main window, and the Settings ⌘, button opens a separate Settings window; the draft-inspector screen itself stays inside the preview panel.

author: Haiku critic
text: The inspector's Done, Undone, Move, Copy and Delete ToolbarButtons duplicate the bulk bar's Done, Undone, Move to..., Copy and Delete buttons, so one job has two widgets. The labels differ (Move vs Move to..., Copy vs Copy as checklist, Delete vs Delete selection) and only the bulk bar's Move is recorded with an ellipsis. Pick one set of labels and one widget per verb for the rebuild, or state why the two are different.

author: Haiku critic
text: The footer hints '⌘\' for hiding the preview panel and '⌘,' for Settings are global-style shortcuts. The web build must let browser shortcuts take precedence, so these keys may not reach the app, and the hint text should be shown only where the shortcut actually works. The desktop build keeps both shortcuts.
